_comment: Schema for mobile request trace entries. Populated at runtime by requestInstrumentation.ts. Call exportTrace() in a dev build to get real data. This file documents the shape — replace with actual exported data from a diagnostic session.
_howToCapture: 1. Run a dev build: npx expo start --go
2. Navigate through the app performing the actions under test
3. In Metro console or shake menu, call: import { exportTrace } from '@/lib/requestInstrumentation'; console.log(exportTrace());

schema.pattern: string — path with IDs normalised to placeholders
schema.startMs: number — epoch ms when request started
schema.durationMs: number — elapsed ms until response or error
schema.requestId: string — unique per request (X-Request-ID header value)
schema.screenName: string — screen that initiated the request
schema.parentActionId: string|null — shared by all requests from same user action (X-Parent-Action-ID)
schema.retryNumber: number — 0 for first attempt, 1 for single retry
